title: SignalProvenance (Action Clearance prerequisites)
description: Design artifact, NOT a committed runtime contract. Additive provenance/integrity projection over the merged TrustedSignal. Consumed (never fetched) by the deterministic evaluator; signature/MAC verification for L2/L3 happens at the ingestion boundary before evaluation.

subject_ref.x-trust: must bind to the action identity

authorization_ref.description: Authorization the signal relates to; null for global signals.

action_fingerprint.description: Exact action the signal relates to; null for non-action-scoped signals.

adapter_id.description: Adapter that normalized the fact (adapter extension).

adapter_version.description: Adapter build/version; must be in approved_versions.

captured_at.description: Source observation time (canonical form; no core clock read).

valid_until.description: Freshness bound; required for time-bounded types.

ingestion_boundary.description: Trust boundary that admitted the signal.

policy_refs.description: Policy/version(s) admitting this source for this signal type.

signature_ref.description: MAC/signature envelope reference; required only for integrity Level 2/3.

x-required-level-by-mode.recommendation: L1 core; L2 for PRIOR_CONSUMPTION and AUTHORIZATION_VALIDITY
x-required-level-by-mode.enforced_execution: L2 minimum; L3 where a producer key exists

signal_replay.behavior: dedup by (signal_id, content_digest); identical fingerprint; no new trust
